lines.text: As Jesus left the temple, He told His disciples that not one stone there would be left on another.
Jesus sat on the Mount of Sinai, and the disciples privately asked about the sign of His coming.
Jesus warned that no one should deceive them, because many would come in His name claiming to be the Christ.
Jesus said wars, famines and plagues were the beginning of birth pains, and the end was still to come.
Jesus said whoever perseveres to the end will be saved, and the gospel will be preached in all the world.
